dedupe_keys.name: dataset for publication material flow analysis as an approach to battery classification for effective waste management a case study in the czech republic

description: The Brno University of Technology team and collaborators publish supporting battery-waste data for the Czech Republic in 2022. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook and README under CC BY 4.0. The published article explicitly links this deposit and describes national-register, take-back-system and mixed-municipal-waste evidence used to reconcile battery flows. These inputs can calibrate collection and recycling scenarios in material-flow simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this national study. The README calls access subscription-based, while Zenodo exposes the files openly and the article says they are public; this inconsistency is recorded, not treated as a payment requirement. Classification gaps and reporting adjustments limit interpretation as direct complete measurements. Workbook sheet definitions and numerical reconciliation remain unverified. No data were downloaded, national totals checked or proposed classification improvements independently tested.
